description.content: Nova Store is a fully custom online shop built for a growing fashion brand. We replaced a slow, template-based site with a lightweight theme and a streamlined checkout.
Payment gateways and a delivery-service API were integrated, so orders are confirmed and shipped without manual work. Page load time dropped from 5.2s to 1.4s.
Pulse is an analytics dashboard that turns raw sales data into clear, interactive charts. Users can filter by date, region, and product in real time.
The UI is built from reusable components with strict typing, which made adding new widgets fast and safe.
A portfolio website for a photography studio. The client needed to edit pages on their own, so we combined a custom theme with a tailored Elementor setup.
Images are lazy-loaded and served in modern formats, keeping the gallery smooth even on mobile connections.
QuickBite is a food delivery platform connecting local restaurants with couriers. Customers track their order live on a map from kitchen to doorstep.
A simple REST API handles orders, courier assignment, and status updates, with webhooks notifying restaurants instantly.
SecureWP is a custom plugin that hardens WordPress sites: login protection, file integrity checks, and automatic blocking of suspicious requests.
Built with clean hooks and filters, it is easy to extend and does not slow down the front end. Admins get a weekly report by email.
